safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not explicitly state the patient normally uses the blue inhaler only as needed; it only gives current use and advice to use PRN.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the reliever (blue) inhaler is normally used only PRN can blur the patient’s baseline control and make it harder to judge how significant the current increase in symptoms/reliever use is. This is unlikely to directly cause harm but can reduce the quality of assessment and follow-up planning.
